name: Fucking My Father
source:
This game follows the stories of three 18 year old girls, as they discover their sexuality. One shall eventually meet her father for the first time, and her two BFFs will join her on this journey of discovery, perhaps discovering a few things of their own along the way...​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/fmf-theatrical-cut-part-1-ohwee-rustyv.78473/]F95zone[/url]]

A parody of [url=/v21234]Dating My Daughter[/url], that uses some assets from that game.
translation:
该游戏讲述了三个18岁女孩发现自己性取向的故事。一个人最终将第一次见到她的父亲，她的两个好朋友将和她一起踏上这段发现之旅，也许一路上会发现一些他们自己的东西……​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/fmf-theatrical-cut-part-1-ohwee-rustyv.78473/]F95zone[/url]]

对 [url=/v21234]Dating My Daughter[/url] 的模仿，使用了该游戏中的一些资源。
